name: Paranoir
source:
[b]Paranoir[/b] is a [b]comical visual novel[/b] that makes you play as an annoyed grandchild, trying their best to help their [b]grandpa[/b] remember the day of his first detective case.

Age is taking a toll on him, and so the flashback might contain some inaccuracies. It's up to you to figure out what is real and what isn't, as you help him [b]remember forgotten words[/b]. 

[From [url=https://lopezr.itch.io/paranoir]Itch.io[/url]]
